results.text: In the UAE, Federal Decree-Law 38 of 2024 allows prescribing outside a product's leaflet, or a product never submitted to the Emirates Drug Establishment (EDE, the federal regulator of medical products since Federal Decree-Law 28/2023) for marketing approval, only when necessary, with no equivalent alternative available and with the patient's approval (Art. 42(1)). In Abu Dhabi, the DoH requires a documented eligibility assessment before peptide therapy and documented informed consent covering expected benefits, uncertainties, risks, alternatives and the product's regulatory approval status (31 July 2026). In Dubai, the DHA does not permit injections or intravenous therapies for 'wellness', 'recovery', 'detoxification' or 'energy enhancement' without a documented medical indication and treatment plan (29 July 2026).
